children: According to ChainCatcher, Tesla has launched FSD V15 in the U.S. and sent the first version to members of its Early Access Program. The update improves handling of safety-critical scenarios by 25 times and introduces the Tesla Reality View interface, which supports full-screen, map, and split-screen views. It also improves driving in adverse road conditions and adds a Bike Rack Mode.

title: Tesla Launches FSD V15 in U.S., Improving Safety-Critical Scenario Handling
